test_dataframe_round_integer: test the DataFrame.round method with an integer decimals argument to round all columns to a fixed precision
test_dataframe_round_dict: test the DataFrame.round method with a dictionary mapping column names to per-column decimal precision values
test_dataframe_round_series: test the DataFrame.round method with a Series of per-column decimal values for rounding
test_dataframe_round_builtin: test the built-in round() function dispatching to DataFrame.round for integer rounding
test_dataframe_round_numpy: test numpy.round dispatching to DataFrame.round with and without the unsupported out parameter
